T009 : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : WSpace n × ℝ → WTarget m) (q : WTarget m),
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (wDomain n) →
    (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => wDensity u (x, t)) volume ∧ ∃ C R B, wLocal u q t C R B) →
      ∀ (t : ℝ),
        0 < t →
          ∀ (j : Fin n),
            (ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => wG u j (x, t)) ∧
              (HasCompactSupport fun x => wG u j (x, t)) ∧
                ∀ (x : WSpace n), wX (wG u j) j (x, t) = wB u j (x, t) + wC u j (x, t)
'Translation.T009' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
